title: Microsoft SQL Server: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The exploit prediction score is 57%.

category.label: Servers and backups
category.why: It runs or protects many systems at once, including your backups.
category.doThis: Patch it and keep its admin access off the internet.

summary: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Aug 29, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2019-1068 as actively exploited
